youtube_description:
Jesus... I was the one who hurt her. It's been three years, and I never said sorry.

Three years ago she hurt her friend and never apologised. Today the friend showed up in her suggestions, and she almost messaged her.

Her: Jesus... I was the one who hurt her. It's been three years, and I never said sorry.

Her: Today she showed up in my suggestions. I almost messaged her, then I closed the app.

Jesus: You've carried this for three years. That tells Me you still care about her.

Her: What if she's moved on? What if she reads it and never replies?

Jesus: She might not. Saying sorry isn't a way to make her answer. It's a way to stop hiding from what you did.

Her: I'm scared it will open everything up again, and she'll remember how much I hurt her.

Jesus: It might. But it might also let both of you finally close it. You can only do your part, so do it honestly.

"If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone."
Romans 12:18 (NIV)

Jesus: Write the message. Leave the reply to Me.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.
